title: The Lost Key
brief:
This chest is locked! You need to pick up the key first.

New tools:

  • is_key_right() — True when there is a key in the tile directly to your right. There are matching sensors for _left(), _up(), and _down().
  • pick_up_key() — picks up a key when you're standing next to it.

An if statement runs its block only when its condition is True. Combine one while loop with one if: walk forward each step, and pick the key up only when you sense it beside you.
